data: Create an original dark cubist mural, hand-painted across a full-frame field of fractured shallow space, with no border and no pasted reference image. Redraw the fictional protagonist Alexandre from the first image only as an abstract visual identity: a mask-like profile with an elongated angular nose, compressed eye, displaced jaw, and a raised arm, preserving the reference’s upward-facing gesture without reproducing its composition. Alexandre rises along a forceful oblique diagonal, lifting an abstract faceted lamp overhead. Its small muted amber glow spreads through a few stained-ivory planes while the rest remains charcoal-black, ash-gray, and stained ivory. Build the figure from interlocking shards, sharp dry-charcoal contours, rough oil scumbling, scraped aged plaster, hairline cracks, and worn patches. Surround Alexandre with opposing mask-like faces and fragmented military silhouettes: angular stars, broken columns, opposing spear-like forms, and abstracted US and Chinese motifs reduced to equal geometric emblems, suggesting military tension and power struggles without literal flags. Let the lamp’s narrow beam divide these hostile forms into unstable wedges, while a tiny pale peace shape fractures near its center. Make every figure, weapon, star, and architectural element equally abstract, with no realistic depth, and let the diagonal structure convey instability and fragile hope.
